The probability is proportional to the central angle of the shaded sector.

- The vertical radius is perpendicular to diameter \(AB\), so the angle between the vertical radius and \(OA\) is \(90^\circ\).
- The slanted radius bounds the shaded sector and makes a \(40^\circ\) angle with the vertical radius.
- Thus the shaded sector’s central angle is
\[
90^\circ-40^\circ=50^\circ.
\]
- Since the point is chosen uniformly from the whole disk,
\[
P=\frac{50^\circ}{360^\circ}=\frac{5}{36}.
\]
